tasks.title: Widen repository query scope to pending+fired, ordered by capture order
tasks.dod: the repository read returns pending and fired reminders ordered by id ASC, verified by an integration test against a real SQLite instance

tasks.title: List use-case: per-row status flag + capture-order truncation
tasks.dod: the view model marks each row scheduled or fired, keeps capture-order position across transitions, and truncates by earliest-added with an overflow indicator, verified by unit tests

tasks.title: List handler: render scheduled/fired flag and suppress Cancel on fired rows
tasks.dod: the rendered list message shows a scheduled/fired flag per row and omits the Cancel action on fired rows, verified by a unit test over the rendered action set

tasks.title: Telegram gateway: drop the Done button from the fired-reminder keyboard
tasks.dod: newly sent fired-reminder messages carry only Snooze and Delete buttons, verified by a unit test on the keyboard builder

tasks.title: Resolve-reminder use-case: guard the done action before any domain call
tasks.dod: action === 'done' is intercepted and returns a not-active outcome without invoking Reminder.resolveDone, verified by a unit test that asserts the domain transition is never called for a still-fired reminder

tasks.title: Resolve handler: map the guarded done outcome to the uniform 'no longer active' reply
tasks.dod: a stale done callback on a fired-and-undeleted reminder replies with the existing uniform not-active message, does not crash, and leaves persisted state unchanged, verified by an integration test

tasks.title: Integration test: list position is stable across fire, deliver, and snooze; only delete removes
tasks.dod: an integration test seeds a reminder, drives fire/deliver/snooze and asserts unchanged list position and continued visibility, then deletes it and asserts it is gone

tasks.title: Integration test: oversized visible set sends exactly one message with overflow indicator
tasks.dod: an integration test seeds more visible reminders than the per-window message limit and asserts exactly one bot message is sent, containing the earliest-added rows plus an overflow indicator

tasks.title: Extend the owner-gate test: non-Owner sees no reminders when fired reminders exist
tasks.dod: the existing owner-gate unit test is extended with a fired reminder in the fixture set and asserts the list command still reveals nothing to a non-Owner

tasks.title: Review fix: include stuck firing reminders in the visible list
tasks.dod: findVisibleOrdered includes pending+firing+fired; a firing reminder maps to the fired status flag and stays at its capture-order position, verified by unit and integration tests

tasks.title: Review fix: stale done tap on a forged reminderId degrades gracefully
tasks.dod: ResolveReminder throws ReminderNotFoundError (not a generic Error) on a missing id, and resolve-handler maps it to the uniform not-active toast for the done action, verified by a unit test
